## {{< bi person-circle >}} About

Cognitive scientist who designs experiments and analyses behavioural data in R and Python.

I am currently contributing to the ESRC funded grant — [Beyond Belief: knowledge and ignorance processing in adults](https://gtr.ukri.org/projects?ref=UKRI559). 

## {{< bi lightbulb-fill >}} Research interests

- Automaticity of mental state attribution (Theory of Mind)
- Immersion and presence in extended reality
- LLM-assisted methods for behavioural research
- Cognitive ethology and ecological validity in experimental design
- Open and reproducible research practices
